_readme: EXAMPLE. Copy to data/gmail-credentials.json and fill in your own Google Cloud OAuth client. All values below are placeholders and grant no access. Create the client in Google Cloud Console: enable the Gmail API, configure an OAuth consent screen, then create an OAuth client of type 'Desktop app' and download its JSON here. The scope requested at run time is gmail.readonly (read-only). Alternatively set GMAIL_CLIENT_ID / GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET in the environment or a .env file (see .env.example) instead of this file.
